{{Short description|Chinese mathematics professor}}

'''Frederick Koon-Shing Leung''' is the Emeritus Professor and Kintoy Professor in Mathematics Education at the Faculty of Education of the [[University of Hong Kong]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=HKU Scholars Hub: Researcher Page |url=https://repository.hku.hk/cris/rp/rp00924 |access-date=2023-11-29 |website=repository.hku.hk}}</ref> He is the President of the [[International Commission on Mathematical Instruction]] (ICMI).<ref>{{cite web |title=ICMI Executive Committee 2021-2024 |url=https://www.mathunion.org/icmi/icmi-executive-committee-2021-2024 |access-date=6 December 2021 |publisher=[[International Commission on Mathematical Instruction]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=ICMI Executive Committee 2021-2024 {{!}} International Mathematical Union (IMU) |url=https://www.mathunion.org/icmi/icmi-executive-committee-2021-2024 |access-date=2023-11-29 |website=www.mathunion.org}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Leung was born and raised in Hong Kong. He studied in [[St. Stephen's College Preparatory School]] and then [[St. Paul's Co-educational College]] in Hong Kong. He became a mathematics teacher after graduating from the University of Hong Kong before joining the university again as a faculty member.  He is married to Shirley Chiu Wing Wong, and they have two sons, King Ho Leung and See Ho Leung.

== Career ==
Leung earned his PhD from the [[University of London Institute of Education]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=New Graduate School Dean Brings a Sense of Belonging |url=https://bulletin.hku.hk/people/new-graduate-school-dean-brings-a-sense-of-belonging/ |access-date=2023-11-29 |website=HKU Bulletin |language=en-US}}</ref>

Leung was awarded the [[Hans Freudenthal|Hans Freudenthal medal]] by the International Commission for Mathematical Instruction in 2013, and was conferred the [[Bronze Bauhinia Star]] (BBS)<ref>{{cite web |title=The 2013 Hans Freudenthal Award |url=https://www.mathunion.org/icmi/awards/past-receipients/2013-hans-freudenthal-award |access-date=6 December 2021 |publisher=[[International Commission on Mathematical Instruction]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Faculty Academics {{!}} HKU - Faculty of Education |url=https://web.edu.hku.hk/faculty-academics/frederickleung |access-date=2023-11-29 |website=web.edu.hku.hk |language=en}}</ref> by the [[Government of Hong Kong|Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region]] in 2017. He was appointed a [[Senior Fulbright Scholar]] in 2003,<ref>{{Cite web |title=RGC-Fulbright (Hong Kong) Scholar Programme - List of Fulbright Scholars (Hong Kong) for 2002/2003 |url=https://www.ugc.edu.hk/eng/rgc/funding_opport/fulbright/funded_research/fhksp2003.html |access-date=2023-11-29 |website=www.ugc.edu.hk}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Frederick Leung {{!}} Fulbright Scholar Program |url=https://fulbrightscholars.org/grantee/frederick-leung |access-date=2023-11-29 |website=fulbrightscholars.org}}</ref> a [[Changjiang Scholars Program|Changjiang Scholar]] by the [[Ministry of Education (China)|Ministry of Education of China]] in 2014,<ref>{{Cite web |title=HKU Education Professor Frederick Leung named the first Changjiang Scholar in Mathematics Education by the Chinese Ministry of Education - All News - Media - HKU |url=https://www.hku.hk/press/news_detail_12080.html |access-date=2023-11-29 |website=www.hku.hk |language=en}}</ref> and he received the World Outstanding Chinese award<ref>{{Cite web |title=歷界世界傑出華人獎得獎者 |url=http://www.wcbfund.org/woca-list.html |access-date=2024-08-01 |website=www.wcbfund.org}}</ref> by the World Chinese Business Investment Foundation in 2015.

Leung was a Member at Large of the Executive Committee of International Commission on Mathematical Instruction (ICMI) from 2003 to 2009 and is the President of ICMI from 2021 to 2024. He was a member of the Standing Committee of International Association for the Evaluation of Academic Achievement (IEA) from 2007 to 2010, then an Honorary member of the [[International Association for the Evaluation of Educational Achievement]] (IEA).<ref>{{Cite web |title=Frederick K.S. Leung elected as an Honorary Member of IEA {{!}} IEA.nl |url=https://www.iea.nl/news-events/news/frederick-ks-leung-elected-honorary-member-iea |access-date=2024-08-01 |website=www.iea.nl}}</ref> in 2019. At the [[University of Hong Kong]], he was recognized as a Distinguished Alumnus of the Faculty of Science in 2019.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Professor Frederick Koon Shing LEUNG - Distinguished Alumni 2019 - Alumni - Faculty of Science, HKU |url=https://www.scifac.hku.hk/alumni/distinguished-alumni-2019/fksleung |access-date=2024-08-01 |website=www.scifac.hku.hk |language=en}}</ref>

== Research Interest ==
Leung's research area is in comparative studies in mathematics education, including student achievement and classroom practices, with a specific focus on the influence of culture on different aspects of mathematics education.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2015-11-02 |title=A Visit by a Hong Kong University Professor |url=https://www.qitepinmath.org/en/our-news/a-visit-by-a-hong-kong-university-professor/ |access-date=2024-08-01 |website=SEAMEO Regional Centre for QITEP in Mathematics |language=en-US}}</ref> He has adopted the perspective of Confucian Heritage Culture (CHC) to explain the superior mathematics achievement of East Asian students in international studies such as the IEA [[Trends in International Mathematics and Science Study|Trends in International Mathematics and Science Studies]] (TIMSS) and the OECD [[Programme for International Student Assessment]] (PISA). Other research interests include the influence of culture (in particular the East Asian culture) on mathematics teaching and learning, mathematics education of children of ethnic minorities in China, and the influence of language on the learning of mathematics.
